user.title: GL One meter
user.description: Enter the pairing/QR id printed on your GL One sensor and what it measures. The install index is the reading the mechanical meter already had when the sensor was fitted (leave 0 to only track consumption since then).

bluetooth_confirm.title: GL One meter
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up the meter with pairing id {device_id}? Choose what it measures. The install index is the reading the mechanical meter already had when the sensor was fitted (leave 0 to only track consumption since then).

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a GL One meter beacon.

error.invalid_device_id: The pairing id must be a positive number.
